title: Warmly Spiced Peruvian Fish Pollo A La Brasa
description: A malty, velvety, weeknight Peruvian dish featuring speculaas spice mix, salt-bake, pescatarian-friendly, in the form of pollo-a-la-brasa, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine, perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together speculaas spice mix, salt, brown sugar, and malt syrup.
Rinse the cod fish fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Place the cod fish fillets in a shallow baking dish and brush them with olive oil.
Sprinkle the speculaas spice mix evenly over the cod fish fillets.
Drizzle lime juice over the cod fish fillets and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Bake the cod fish fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the cod fish fillets from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
